title: Angel EXT. ROCKS – NIGHT
excerpt: Digital composition, 24. A frame that never made it into any film but felt like it should have.
body:
Digital, 24

A frame that never made it into any film but felt like it should have. The rocks were real. The angel was not.

title: Queen of Hearts
excerpt: Oil on Canvas. Painted from a photograph found at a flea market. She belongs to no one.
body:
Oil on Canvas, 24

Painted from a photograph found at a flea market. She belongs to no one, which made her interesting to me.

title: Skull
excerpt: Graphite on Paper, 23. A classical study. The exercise of rendering death in 2H pencil.
body:
Graphite on Paper, 23

A classical study. The exercise of rendering death in 2H pencil feels both morbid and meditative. Recommended.

title: Louise
excerpt: Oil on Wood, 23. She lives on the island of Silas now, in the Bay of Biscay.
body:
Oil on Wood, 23

She lives on the island of Silas now, in the Bay of Biscay. Painting her felt like building a room someone would later inhabit.

excerpt: Film, 19. Shot on whatever was available at the time. It is exactly what it sounds like.
body:
Film, 19

Shot on whatever was available at the time. It is exactly what it sounds like, which is either a strength or a weakness depending on the day.
